Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a PMP Exam situational or practice question.

eco_domain.description: The PMP Exam Content Outline domain.

scenario.description: The situational corporate scenario representing real-world PM conflicts.

options.description: Four multiple-choice options (A, B, C, D).

correct_option.description: The correct option corresponding to the PMBOK 8 / Agile mindset.

explanation.description: Detailed explanation and coaching from the AI Coach explaining why options are correct/incorrect.

pmbok_8_reference.description: Exact mapping to PMBOK Guide 8th Edition principles/domains.

tags.description: Contextual environment tags like AI, sustainability, data-driven.

UserSession.title: UserSession
UserSession.description: Stores user statistics, mastery percentages, and tracking matrices.

incorrectIds.description: List of question IDs where the user gave incorrect answers.

answeredQuestions.description: Map of question_id to selected_option to preserve answers across restarts.

mastery.description: Domain percentages: People, Process, Business Environment successes.

durationOfUtilization.description: Cumulative time in seconds spent utilizing the simulator.

accessStatus.description: Status of the user's access ('granted' or 'restricted').

testsCount.description: The number of exam sessions launched.

ConfigSettings.title: ConfigSettings
ConfigSettings.description: Global administrator configurations like timers and test counts.

examTimerMinutes.description: Maximum exam timer limit in minutes.

maxTestsLimit.description: Allowed number of mock exam attempts.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Master list of all generated or active questions in the simulator.

/sessions/{userId}.description: Individual project manager's testing progress and target metric matrices.
